cause_quote: The new `savedLayout.dashboardPresentationOverride === undefined` guard restricted direct restoration to legacy layouts and sent other saved layouts through `this.showDashboard(...)`, whose split path calls `openSlot(next, "conversation")` when Dashboard is the main panel.
user_saw: Reloading a split dashboard switched the selected side tab from Side chat or Files to Chat.
summary: The fix restores the saved panel arrangement when it already matches the effective dashboard presentation.
reasoning: Before #146475, passive activation only called `showDashboard` for an explicit expanded route or when there was no saved layout, and the parent already had browser coverage for preserving a saved side selection across a dashboard reload. The shared-defaults commit made passive activation reopen the split view for layouts with presentation metadata, and I verified that `openSlot` selects the conversation panel by setting `activePanelId`.
